title: Odyssey-3 is a new generative world model that you can try for free
summary: Odyssey is making its world model Odyssey-3 available as a public research preview. The 14-billion-parameter model generates interactive environments from text prompts in real time and can reportedly control robots, drones, and even GTA V. Odyssey claims top scores on physics benchmarks, though the methodology behind those results has limits. The article Odyssey-3 is a new generative world model that you can try for free appeared first on The Decoder .
